# KidBookMaker

> KidBookMaker turns your story into a real, fully illustrated picture book. It can star your child, your whole family, or a friend (as a gift), or bring any story in your head to life. You type, record, or upload the story (a single sentence is enough), optionally add up to 3 photos, and KidBookMaker writes it into pages, illustrates every scene in a consistent storybook style, emails a preview (usually the same day) to change as much as you like, and prints a real hardcover once you approve. Books are made in English or Spanish. There is nothing to pay until the book is approved; the price is shown with the preview.

What makes it different from other ways to "make a book online":
- No templates and no fill-in-the-name stories: each book is built from your own idea and words.
- No drawing, design software, or page-by-page layout work for the family. Their part takes a few minutes.
- Real people can star: from optional photos, the characters are drawn to look like your child, your family, or a friend. Or no real people at all.
- Every book is made to be printed as a real hardcover, and every word and picture can be changed before printing.
- English and Spanish (a dedicated Spanish page; Spanish stories get a fully Spanish book and Spanish emails).
